## Summary

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace --all-targets`
- [ ] Documentation updated where behavior changed
- [ ] Language changes include tests and, when required, an RFC

## Compatibility / security impact

Describe syntax, semantic, runtime, interoperability, or security implications.
